title: Phase 7: first review set
notes: The first committed gallery: 0.5 m voxels, arcade palette, orange UI, two-brick weapons, control hint in the round.

title: Pre-overhaul: propane cages as lattices
notes: Same build with lattice propane cages so the bottles show; the set the overhaul review was made against.

title: Visual overhaul
notes: 0.25 m voxels in a 96 m arena, detailed structures and props, road markings, weapons with hands, neon UI with anchored HUD plates, controls on the loadout screen, dusk skies.

title: Combo meter and leveled rewards
notes: Combo plate with multiplier, chain, meter and power-boost timer; leveling refills a magazine and boosts power; smaller ammo plate with the C4 pip column; grenade count as a number.
